title: cotton laundry bags
text: cotton laundry bags. Husband travels a LOT.  He takes his laundry to wash and fold places.  These laundry bags are the perfect way to "travel" the dirty clothes to the dry cleaners.  They are not super thick, but heavy enough to last a while.  Because they are cotton, the bags wash up nicely too. You get 2 bags.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
